item.title: CVE-2026-133857 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | Uncontrolled resource allocation in Kibana exception-list filter creation can lead to denial of service. An authenticated user with access to the Security solution can submit a specially crafted request containing a large number of exception-list identifiers. Kibana can create an unbounded number of concurrent operations while resolving those identifiers, exhausting memory and crashing the Kibana process.

item.title: CVE-2026-133858 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | Certain Fleet APIs in Kibana expose stored credentials to authenticated users who do not have the Fleet Settings: Read privilege. For example, a user with the Fleet Agent policies: Read privilege can retrieve credentials through Fleet output and agent binary download source APIs. The disclosed credentials could allow the attacker to authenticate to connected backend systems.

item.title: CVE-2026-133860 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.9
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.9 | An issue in Kibana allows Elasticsearch transforms in directly uploaded integration packages to run with Kibana's internal system identity instead of the installing user's privileges. A user with Integrations: All and Agent policies: All privileges in a single Kibana space could access or modify data they are not authorized to access, including agent policies from other spaces. This could disclose sensitive information or lead to command execution on managed Elastic Agent hosts.

item.title: CVE-2026-133891 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3 | Incorrect authorization in Elasticsearch columnar indices can bypass field-level security for geo_shape values. An authenticated user with access to an affected index can obtain denied geometry values through the internal source-geometry representation even when field-level security excludes the corresponding field. This discloses field data that the user is not authorized to read.

item.title: CVE-2026-133917 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3 | Elasticsearch ES|QL query responses can disclose dataset storage locations and provider identity details to users who are allowed to query a dataset but cannot read its definition. Storage paths and storage-client error text can appear in read-failure messages or query-profile plan strings. An authenticated dataset reader can obtain this information without permission to view the dataset configuration. This issue does not disclose stored credentials or the dataset contents beyond the caller's query access.

item.title: CVE-2026-133918 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.4
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.4 | Elasticsearch ES|QL data-source and dataset registration can write storage credentials or pre-signed URL signatures to the audit log in plaintext. In affected versions, request definitions are not appropriately filtered before request-body or URL-query auditing. An attacker with access to these logs can obtain credentials for the customer's external storage. The issue affects deployments with ES|QL federation enabled and audit logging configured to record the affected request information.

item.title: CVE-2026-133919 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.9
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.9 | Uncontrolled resource allocation in Elasticsearch mapping updates can lead to denial of service. An authenticated user with index-management privileges can submit specially crafted mapping updates that are expanded into multiple large in-memory representations. The amplification during request parsing and mapping updates can exhaust heap memory and crash an Elasticsearch node.

item.title: CVE-2026-133925 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | Uncontrolled resource consumption in Elasticsearch query parsing can lead to denial of service. An authenticated user with search permissions can submit a specially crafted query containing an excessive number of clauses. Expanding those clauses in memory before enforcing query complexity limits can exhaust heap memory and crash an Elasticsearch node.

item.title: CVE-2026-133926 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3 | An issue was discovered in Kibana where a user with the Synthetics All privilege in one space can access Fleet agent policy metadata from other spaces through a product API endpoint. This could lead to the unauthorized disclosure of operational metadata across spaces the user is not authorized to view.

item.title: CVE-2026-133935 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8 | Unconstrained S3 endpoint settings in Elasticsearch ES|QL data sources can cause requests containing storage credentials to be sent to an attacker-controlled host. A user with data-source management privileges can configure a custom endpoint without the intended host restriction. On opted-in commercial Elastic Cloud Hosted deployments, the issue can also disclose workload-identity tokens and expose customer cloud resources outside Elasticsearch. Self-managed deployments are affected by the storage-endpoint path only.

item.title: CVE-2026-133984 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.2
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.2 | Missing authorization in Kibana Cases alert attachments can allow an authenticated user with permission to add case comments or attachments to modify case-link metadata in documents they are not authorized to access. An attacker can add false case links and prevent legitimate case linkage by exhausting the alert's case-link limit. Writes are limited to the kibana.alert.case_ids field in indices that Kibana's internal account can read and update and whose mappings accept that field. One of the two authorization defects was fixed earlier in 8.19.22, 9.4.8 and 9.5.5; the fixed versions listed in this advisory address both defects.

item.title: CVE-2026-134059 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | A relative path traversal vulnerability in Kibana Fleet and Elastic Agent allows an authenticated user with both Fleet Integrations: All and Agent policies: All privileges to distribute a malicious integration policy to managed Elastic Agents. A vulnerable Elastic Agent processing that policy for a component that runs in an isolated unit can modify or delete files outside the component's intended runtime directory with the privileges of the Elastic Agent process. This can cause loss of files or persistent denial of service on affected hosts.

item.title: CVE-2026-135472 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.9
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.9 | open62541 1.5.0 through 1.5.10 contains a use-after-free and double free vulnerability in the lookupRefType() function in src/util/ua_util.c that allows attackers to corrupt the heap of the server process by supplying a RelativePath string resolved through UA_RelativePath_parseWithServer(). When the path names a ReferenceType with a string or GUID NodeId, the function returns a shallow copy of the browse result's NodeId and frees its identifier, causing the identifier to be freed a second time when the parsed path is cleared, which attackers can exploit to crash the server process.

item.title: CVE-2026-135617 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Lookyloo is a web-based URL capture and analysis platform. Prior to the fix, the authorization mechanism for private captures (seed-based access control) was not consistently enforced at the data access layer. The capture_cache method and numerous internal methods (get_info, get_meta, get_statistics, get_modules_responses, get_data, get_video, get_screenshot, get_har, get_cookies, get_storage_state, get_frames, get_console_messages, get_capture, get_ressource, misp_export, lacus_export, ai_export, comparator functions, and others) could be invoked with only a capture UUID without validating the required seed token. This meant that API endpoints and internal code paths that called these methods directly could return private capture data to unauthenticated users or users lacking the correct seed. The before_request hook in the web interface provided a partial check, but the underlying data layer did not enforce it, creating an inconsistent authorization boundary. An attacker who knew or guessed a private capture UUID could potentially access sensitive data including rendered screenshots, HAR files, downloaded files, cookies, storage state, console messages, and MISP exports through various REST API endpoints and web routes. The fix introduces a LookylooPrivateCapture exception raised at the cache layer when a private capture is accessed without a valid seed, refactors the API to pass CaptureCache objects (already validated) rather than raw UUIDs, and ensures all web and API endpoints propagate the session-known seed or admin status to the data access layer. Background processes use an explicit unsafe=True flag to bypass the check, as they operate server-side with full trust.

item.title: CVE-2026-82303 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5 | A buffer over-read vulnerability in Elasticsearch transport decompression can expose data from other requests. The LZ4 decoder can read beyond the declared compressed block into a shared network buffer. A remote attacker who can reach an affected transport interface can send a specially crafted compressed request and obtain data from outside their own request. Exploitation of the exposed remote-cluster transport interface does not require authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-130165 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces. In versions prior to 19.0.9, 19.1.10, 19.2.9 and 19.3.1, react-server-dom-webpack, react-server-dom-parcel, and react-server-dom-turbopack are vulnerable to denial of service. item.title: CVE-2026-132615 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The ggml-rpc server suffers from an uninitialized heap memory disclosure vulnerability where the alloc_buffer function provides new clients with buffers containing stale data from previously freed allocations. This allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to perform an in-bounds read via get_tensor to recover sensitive information, such as model weights or KV-cache data, belonging to other clients sharing the same server.

item.title: CVE-2026-133981 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | An issue was discovered in Elasticsearch where specially crafted compressed payloads can cause an infinite loop. A low-privileged authenticated user can submit a malformed payload to a product API endpoint that causes the node to enter a permanent CPU loop, occupying a request-processing thread indefinitely. This can progressively exhaust the node's processing capacity, degrading or denying access to product features, and requiring a restart of the affected node to recover.

item.title: CVE-2026-134069 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description:
Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | Use of a default cryptographic key in the instance registration component in Amazon SSM Agent before 3.3.5226.0 on AWS-provided Windows Server AMIs released before 2026-09-09 might allow local users without administrative privileges to obtain the instance's Default Host Management Configuration role credentials via the registration key shared by all instances launched from the same AMI.
To remediate this issue, users should replace affected instances with instances launched from AWS Windows Server AMIs released on or after 2026-09-09, which include SSM Agent 3.3.5226.0 or later. Upgrading the agent in place does not replace the shared key, and deleting the agent's Vault breaks instances managed through Default Host Management Configuration.
